query.name: environment-list
query.comment: Get the list of environment variables
query.sql: SELECT env.name AS name, env.value AS value, COALESCE(project.name, '') AS project_name, COALESCE(branch.name, '') AS branch_name, COALESCE(recipe.name, '') AS recipe_name, COALESCE(node.name, '') AS node_name FROM porion_environment AS env LEFT JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON env.branch_id = branch.id LEFT JOIN porion_project AS project ON env.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN porion_node AS node ON env.node_id = node.id LEFT JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON env.recipe_id = recipe.id ORDER BY node_name, project_name, branch_name, recipe_name, name
query.sql-count: SELECT count(env.id) FROM porion_environment AS env

query.name: project-environment-list
query.comment: Get the list of environment variables
query.sql: SELECT env.name AS name, env.value AS value, project.name AS name, COALESCE(branch.name, '') AS branch_name, COALESCE(recipe.name, '') AS recipe_name, COALESCE(node.name, '') AS node_name FROM porion_environment AS env LEFT JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON env.branch_id = branch.id LEFT JOIN porion_project AS project ON env.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN porion_node AS node ON env.node_id = node.id WHERE env.project_id = :project_id OR env.project_id IS NULL
query.sql-count: SELECT count(env.id) FROM porion_environment AS env WHERE env.project_id = :project_id OR env.project_id IS NULL
